name: AWS account and region
identity: a role per unit; a permissions boundary when given
notes: The CloudFront certificate and web ACL must be in us-east-1

name: VPC with public and private subnets
hosts: the sweep task; Neptune; the graph tools
sizing: 10.42.0.0/16; two to six zones; an S3 gateway endpoint; no NAT by default
notes: Public subnets egress only; private subnets no route out unless enable_nat

name: ECR repositories
sizing: last ten images kept; scan on push

name: ECS cluster on Fargate
notes: One task at a time by the lake lock

name: AgentCore Runtime
sizing: arm64 container; idle two hours; lifetime eight hours
identity: the runtime role; a Cognito JWT authoriser
notes: PUBLIC network mode; an optional prod endpoint

name: AgentCore Gateway
hosts: the MCP front of SV-004 and SV-005; SV-006 as interceptor
identity: the gateway role; a Cognito JWT authoriser

name: AWS Lambda
sizing: python3.12; 1024 MB; the portal 600 s with reserved concurrency
notes: The graph tools in the private subnets; the rest outside the VPC

name: API Gateway HTTP API
identity: a Cognito JWT authoriser or none in site mode

name: CloudFront distribution
sizing: PriceClass_100; optional custom domain and web ACL
identity: origin access control; the origin secret header

name: Amazon Neptune cluster
notes: Private subnets; port 8182 to two security groups

name: Amazon Bedrock
hosts: models; the Knowledge Base; the guardrail
optional: models always; the Knowledge Base optional
identity: the callers' roles with model grants scoped to the configured ids
notes: Model access must be granted in the account first

name: Amazon Cognito user pool
notes: Signs no one in with site_sign_in; still holds the service clients

name: CodeBuild projects
hosts: the two image builds; the launch stack's deployer
identity: the codebuild role; the deployer role (administrator)
notes: Started by an object-created rule on the build bucket

name: An operator's machine
hosts: SV-008 SV-009 and the local profile
notes: A folder lake; the Anthropic API or AWS credentials

name: Optional backend hosts
hosts: Neo4j or AuraDB; PostgreSQL with Apache AGE; MongoDB
identity: connection strings from the deployment's secret store
notes: Contract tests run against emulators in CI

name: EventBridge SQS Pipes and Scheduler
hosts: the upload and build triggers; the sweep schedule
sizing: queue retention one day; DLQ fourteen; schedule rate(6 hours)
